notes.title: Flat Eye Modules | HeartfeltGifts
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41653549/33e7bdeaa642e4ccaeabcb731cf1dfad1f1f10bf.png[/img]

[h2]Introducing HeartfeltGifts!
[/h2]

A practical module that has survived the test of time and technological advancements, the VendingMachine offers Customers whatever items are stocked at the press of a button. However, with the appropriate upgrades, you can take this simple module and bring it to the future. 

Introducing - the HeartfeltGifts. This upgraded version does require additional modules to help support it, but once it’s up and running Customers can fulfill all their organ needs. Do you need a heart or a lung? We got you covered. 

[i][h3]Flat Eye - our hearts are ripe for the harvest![/h3]
[/i]

notes.title: Flat Eye Modules | DoctorBooth
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41653549/667b7df0e6a933e52f4d2e47c842c50244850b0d.png[/img]

[h2]Introducing the DoctorBooth![/h2]

Have a weird pain that just won’t go away? Been coughing up blood? We have the solution for you, with our DoctorBooth. By stepping into it, the booth will analyze and check your entire body before diagnosing your illness and in some cases, provide you with a cure through one of our other modules. Why bother making an appointment when you can find all the medical answers you require through a simple scan and the press of a button? 

[i][i][h3]Flat Eye - One DoctorBooth a day keeps the doctor away[/h3] [/i]
[/i]

notes.title: Flat Eye Modules | CashSmart
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41653549/1551460f35234ee58d29f6d0c1aabd7de32004c3.png[/img]
[h2]Introducing the CashSmart!
[/h2]

The center point for the entire Flat Eye station when you are just starting off, the CashRegister does exactly what you would expect - it scans simple items for purchase. Except it breaks… a lot. And Customers generally don’t like that.

Once you’ve accumulated enough money, you can even replace it with its more reliable upgraded version - the CashSmart, which works by itself, utilizes a simple-to-understand touch screen, and puts the power of the purchase into the Customers hands. 

[i][h3]Flat Eye - making even the smallest interactions as smooth as possible. [/h3]
[/i]
